**Live data since ${go_live}; earlier history was imported.** Flights from 24-08-2025 to 06-03-2026 and controller sessions from 24-08-2025 to 15-03-2026 come from the previous system (no speed, altitude or SELCAL for imported flights). There are no flights after 06-03-2026 and no controller sessions after 15-03-2026 until ${go_live}. Panels for the last 7 or 30 days and the live tables show current data only. All times are UTC. Position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period shown, summed per position type. Two CTR sectors online together for 3 hours count as 6. The type is the callsign suffix, so APP and DEP are separate and CTR excludes FSS. FMP may often show 0.

panels.title: ATC hours staffed by position type (7 days, 30 days, last full month, since go-live)
panels.description: Hours each position type was staffed in fixed windows ending now (7 and 30 days), the last full calendar month (UTC), and since go-live on 07-10-2026. Position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period shown, summed per position type. Two CTR sectors online together for 3 hours count as 6 hours. The type is the callsign suffix (_CTR, _TWR, _APP, _DEP, _GND, _DEL, _FSS, _FMP), not the feed's facility number, so APP and DEP are separate and CTR excludes FSS. All session time counts, with no minimum length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. FMP may often show 0: it has not been checked how it appears in the feed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t(ptype, ord) AS (
  VALUES ('CTR', 1), ('TWR', 2), ('APP', 3), ('DEP', 4), ('GND', 5), ('DEL', 6), ('FSS', 7), ('FMP', 8)
), s AS (
  SELECT substring(callsign FROM '_(CTR|TWR|APP|DEP|GND|DEL|FSS|FMP)$') AS ptype, session_start, session_end
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE callsign ~ '_(CTR|TWR|APP|DEP|GND|DEL|FSS|FMP)$'
), b AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS this_month,
         date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - interval '1 month') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_month
)
SELECT t.ptype AS "Position type",
       round(coalesce(sum(greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '7 days')), 0)) FILTER (WHERE s.session_start IS NOT NULL), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Last 7 days",
       round(coalesce(sum(greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0)) FILTER (WHERE s.session_start IS NOT NULL), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Last 30 days",
       round(coalesce(sum(greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, b.this_month) - greatest(s.session_start, b.last_month)), 0)) FILTER (WHERE s.session_start IS NOT NULL), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Last full month",
       round(coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM s.session_end - s.session_start)), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Since go-live"
FROM t CROSS JOIN b LEFT JOIN s USING (ptype)
GROUP BY t.ptype, t.ord
ORDER BY t.ord

panels.title: ATC hours staffed per week, by position type
panels.description: Hours each position type was staffed, per calendar week (UTC). Position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period shown, summed per position type. Two CTR sectors online together for 3 hours count as 6 hours. The type is the callsign suffix (_CTR, _TWR, _APP, _DEP, _GND, _DEL, _FSS, _FMP), not the feed's facility number, so APP and DEP are separate and CTR excludes FSS. All session time counts, with no minimum length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. The CTR line can differ slightly from 'CTR hours staffed per week' on the ATC: controllers dashboard, which credits a whole session to the week it started and uses the feed's facility code.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT substring(callsign FROM '_(CTR|TWR|APP|DEP|GND|DEL|FSS|FMP)$') AS ptype,
         session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS s_from, session_end AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS s_to
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE callsign ~ '_(CTR|TWR|APP|DEP|GND|DEL|FSS|FMP)$'
    AND session_end >= date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND session_start <= $__timeTo()
), w AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
                         date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), interval '1 week') AS wk
)
SELECT w.wk AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, s.ptype AS metric,
       round(sum(extract(epoch FROM least(s.s_to, w.wk + interval '1 week') - greatest(s.s_from, w.wk))) / 3600.0, 1) AS "hours"
FROM w JOIN s ON s.s_from < w.wk + interval '1 week' AND s.s_to > w.wk
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
